feature_policy: Predeclared compact model0-consumer subset; career-only fighter state plus age/layoff. No outcome-driven selection.

preprocessing.paired_projection: For each fighter-side pair, fit one pooled training-fold median across both sides, impute each side with that shared median, emit f1-minus-f2 and missing(f1)-missing(f2).
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler fit on training fold only
preprocessing.orientation: All model inputs are antisymmetric under fighter swap; logistic fit_intercept=false.

baselines.empirical: Laplace-smoothed probability that the more-experienced fighter wins, estimated from unequal prior-fight-count training rows only; ties=0.5.
baselines.logistic: L2 logistic regression, C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=2000, random_state=17, fit_intercept=false

verdict_rule.confirmed: OOF logistic improves log loss by >=0.01 and Brier by >=0.005 vs 50/50, beats empirical on both aggregate primary metrics, and improves both primary metrics vs 50/50 in at least two-thirds of outer folds.
verdict_rule.weak_but_present: OOF logistic improves both primary metrics vs 50/50 and improves both in at least half of outer folds.
